y-m-02-03.title: Incwadi ekwisithathu ukusuka ekhohlo, ikwiphi indawo ukusuka ekunene?
y-m-02-03.goal: Thi indawo enye ngenani elibaliwe ukusuka ekhohlo nenani elibaliwe ukusuka ekunene, fumana ipatheni phakathi kwamanani amabini, yenza iindawo ezininzi ezinokwenzeka, uze ufumane iimeko apho ulwazi lungekho.
y-m-02-03.material: Iincwadi ezi-7 zimi emgceni kwishelufu enye yekhabhathi yeencwadi. Ekhohlo nasekunene yicala lasekhohlo nelasekunene njengoko libonwa umile phambi kwekhabhathi yeencwadi. Iincwadi zikumgca oqhubekayo ngaphandle kwezikhewu. UMina ubale incwadi eblowu ukusuka ekhohlo wathi 'yesibini', kwaye uSeohyeon wabala ukusuka ekunene wathi 'yesithandathu'. Bobabini babale ngokuchanekileyo.
y-m-02-03.thinking.0: Ukwazi ukuba xa isalathiso sitshintsha, amagama okubiza into enye nawo ayatshintsha
y-m-02-03.prereq.1: Amagama abonisa ulandelelwano njengokuqala, okwesibini, nokwesithathu
y-m-02-03.s.s1.prompt: Ingaba iincwadi ezithethwa nguMina noSeohyeon zinokuba yincwadi enye?
y-m-02-03.s.s1.hint.0: Zoba iincwadi ezi-7 njengemijikelezo emi-7 ubhale amanani 1, 2, 3, ... ukusuka ngasekhohlo.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kwiimijikelezo ezifanayo, bhala namanani abaliwe ukusuka ngasekunene uze ufumane indawo yesibini.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.o.a: Ziincwadi ezahlukeneyo. Okwesibini nokwesithandathu ziindawo ezahlukeneyo
y-m-02-03.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ukuba amanani abaliweyo ahlukeneyo athetha iindawo ezahlukeneyo. Ngaba ucinge ngokuba umqolo ubalwa usuka kweliphi icala?
y-m-02-03.s.s1.o.b: Zinokuba yincwadi enye. Zibale zisuka kumacala achaseneyo
y-m-02-03.s.s1.r.b: Le ngcamango ithi ukuba icala obala ngalo lahlukile, incwadi enye inokufumana inani elahlukileyo.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.o.c: Awunakukwazi ukuxela. Kuba awazi ukuba zingaphi iincwadi
y-m-02-03.s.s1.r.c: Ushiye ulwazi lokuba zikho iincwadi ezi-7. Jonga ukuba ulwazi olufunekayo lukhona na kule meko.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.explain: Ukuba umqolo unezincwadi ezi-7, zikho iincwadi ezi-5 ngasekunene kwencwadi yesibini esuka ngasekhohlo. Ibonwa ukusuka ngasekunene, loo ncwadi inezincwadi ezi-5 phambi kwayo, ngoko yeyesithandathu. Amanani ahluke kuphela kuba icala elibalwa ngalo lahlukile; yincwadi enye.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.prompt: Incwadi ebomvu ikwishelufu yeencwadi efanayo (iincwadi ezi-7). Yenza iindawo ezi-2 ezahlukeneyo ukuze incwadi ebomvu ibe ngasekhohlo kwindawo ephakathi (yesine). Bhala kwi-a indawo esuka ngasekhohlo kwaye kwi-b indawo esuka ngasekunene. Amanani amabini kufuneka akhombe kwincwadi enye.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.hint.0: Qala ngokubhala inani elibalwe ngasekhohlo kunye nelibalwe ngasekunene kunye kumqolo wemijikelezo emi-7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qala ubale ukuba zingaphi iindawo ezikhoyo ngasekhohlo kwindawo ephakathi (yesine).
y-m-02-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Inani elibalwe ngasekhohlo linani elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Inani elibalwe ngasekhohlo kufuneka libe linani lemvelo elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Inani elibalwe ngasekunene linani elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Inani elibalwe ngasekunene kufuneka libe linani lemvelo elisuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.fail.c3: La manani amabini akakhombi kwincwadi enye. Bhala amanani kumqolo weencwadi ezi-7 ukhangele.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.explain: Iindawo ezinokwenzeka zintathu: (1,7), (2,6), kunye (3,5). Indawo yesine yeyesine isuka ngasekhohlo kwaye iyeyesine isuka ngasekunene, ngoko ayikho 'ngasekhohlo kwindawo ephakathi'.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala, usebenzisa amanani, indlela b emiselwa ngayo xa a imisiwe, oko kukuthi ipatheni oyifumeneyo phakathi kwamanani amabini.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala amanani amabini eendawo ezimbini owazenzileyo secaleni uthelekise indlela anxulumene ngayo.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Jonga okwenzekayo kwinani lasekunene xa inani lasekhohlo lenyuka nge-1.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.placeholder: Umzekelo: Ukuba yeyesi-... isuka ngasekhohlo, yeyesi-... isuka ngasekunene.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba ipatheni oyibhalileyo ilungile kwiindawo ezimbini okanye ngaphezulu ozenzileyo?
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ubhale uyazi ukuba ipatheni isetyenziswa kuphela xa kukho iincwadi ezi-7?
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Ukuba yeye-3 isuka ngasekhohlo, yeye-5 isuka ngasekunene. Xa udibanisa amanani amabini, ihlala i-8.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Ngalo lonke ixesha inani lasekhohlo lenyuka nge-1, inani lasekunene lisihla nge-1. Njengeye-1 neye-7, eye-2 neye-6.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Kuthiwe ngendlela etshintsha ngayo ngaphandle kokusebenzisa isixa. Oku nako kuyasebenza.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.prompt: Kwesinye isitya seencwadi, awazi ukuba zingaphi iincwadi. Uxelelwe kuphela ukuba incwadi eluhlaza yeyesithathu isuka ngasekhohlo. Ungathi le ncwadi yeyiphi isuka ngasekunene?
y-m-02-03.s.s3.hint.0: Cinga ngokubeka enye incwadi esiphelweni sasekunene ujonge ukuba ulandelelwano lwencwadi eluhlaza esuka ngasekhohlo luyatshintsha na.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.hint.1: Zoba ityala leencwadi ezi-5 neelinye leencwadi ezi-7 uthelekise ukuba yeyiphi isuka ngasekunene.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.o.a: Ungathi kuphela ukuba uyazi ukuba zingaphi iincwadi zonke
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.a: Uhlolisise ukuba ulwazi luyanela na wathi yintoni elahlekileyo.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.o.b: Cinga ukuba enye ishelufu nayo inezincwadi ezi-7 uthi yeyesihlanu isuka ngasekunene
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.b: Uthwale ulwazi lokuba ishelufu yangaphambili yayinezincwadi ezi-7 wayisa ngqo kule shelufu. Ayizange ixelelwe ukuba le shelufu inezincwadi zingaphi.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.c: Usebenzise inani elibalwe ngasekhohlo ngendlela efanayo kwelasekunene. Cinga ngokwenzekayo ukuba ayiyiyo incwadi ephakathi.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.o.d: Nokuba zingaphi iincwadi, indawo esuka ngasekunene imiselwe
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.d: Ucinge ukuba inani lihlala linjalo nokuba iincwadi ziyanda. Cinga ngokwenzekayo ukuba ubeka enye incwadi ngasekunene.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.explain: Ukwazi kuphela ukuba yeyesithathu isuka ngasekhohlo, awukwazi ukuxela ukuba zingaphi iincwadi ezingasekunene kwayo. Ukuba kukho iincwadi ezi-5, yeyesithathu isuka ngasekunene, kwaye ukuba kukho iincwadi ezi-7, yeyesihlanu isuka ngasekunene. Unokugqiba kuphela xa wazi ukuba zingaphi iincwadi zonke.

y-m-02-05.title: Ukuba uphawu lokugqibela lukhulu, ingaba lude ngakumbi?
y-m-02-05.goal: Qonda ukuba ulwazi lwesiphelo esinye kuphela alwanelanga ukuthelekisa ubude, uthi kufuneka wazi nokuba ngamnye uqala phi, ulungise isigwebo sakho sokuqala ngolwazi olutsha, uze ukhethe indlela yokuthelekisa ngqo.
y-m-02-05.material: Kwidesika, ipensile 가 nepensile 나 zilele ngqo secaleni kwicala lomlawuli. Umlawuli unemigca eyi-0 ukuya kwi-10, kwaye izithuba phakathi kwemigca zonke ziyalingana. Konke ongakubona ngoku ziziphelo zasekunene. Isiphelo sasekunene sepensile 가 sisemgceni we-9, kwaye isiphelo sasekunene sepensile 나 sisemgceni we-8. Awukazibonanga iziphelo zasekhohlo zepensile ezimbini. U-Eunseo wathi, "isiphelo se-가 sifikelela kumgca we-9, ngoko 가 inde ngakumbi."
y-m-02-05.prereq.0: Intsingiselo ye-0 kumlawuli nesithuba esinye phakathi kwemigca
y-m-02-05.prereq.1: Ukuthelekisa ubude ngamazwi njenge-'nde ngakumbi / mfutshane ngakumbi / lilinganayo'
y-m-02-05.s.s1.prompt: Yintoni enye ekufuneka uyazi ukugqiba ukuba amazwi ka-Eunseo alungile na?
y-m-02-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ngepensile enye elele kumlawuli, uthi kufuneka wazi indawo yayo kwimigca emingaphi ukwazi ubude bayo.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa indlela ubude obahluka ngayo xa isiphelo sasekhohlo sepensile enesiphelo sasekunene se-9 sisekhonkwe kwi-0 nalapho sisekhonkwe kwi-7.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.a: Ubungqingqwa alulolwazi lusetyenziselwa ukuthelekisa ubude. Ubude bumiselwa kukuba bususela phi ukuya phi.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.o.b: Zingaphi izithuba ezisele ukuya esiphelweni somlawuli (umgca we-10)
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.b: Sele uyazi umgca wesiphelo sasekunene, ngoko oku kuphindaphinda ulwazi olufanayo. Jonga ukuba likuxelela into entsha na.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.o.c: Isiphelo sasekhohlo sepensile nganye kwezimbini sisemgceni ongaphi
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.c: Ubone ukuba ufuna zombini apho ipensile iqala khona nalapho iphelela khona.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.o.d: Yeyiphi kwiipensile ezimbini ebukhali ngakumbi kwincam
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.d: Kufuneka ujonge apho ipensile ibekwe khona, hayi indlela ebukhali ngayo. Cinga ukuba ngowuphi ulwazi olufunekayo xa ufunda ubude kwimigca.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.explain: Ubude busuka kwindawo apho ipensile iqala ukuya kwindawo apho iphela khona. Umgca wesiphelo sasekunene wodwa awunakugqiba ukuba yeyiphi ipensile ende ngakumbi; kufuneka wazi ukuba isiphelo sasekhohlo sisemgceni ongaphi.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.prompt: Ngoku iziphelo zasekhohlo ziyaziwa. 가 iqala emgceni we-5 kwaye 나 iqala emgceni we-0. USeohyeon wacinga kwakhona ngolu lwazi. Khetha umgca kumazwi kaSeohyeon onzima ukuwuthemba.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.hint.0: Khomba ngomnwe wakho imigca ukusuka ekuphi ukuya ekuphi 가 ne-나 nganye zilele khona, ubale izithuba.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.hint.1: Khangela ukuba ipensile enomgca omkhulu wesiphelo nayo yaqala kwindawo efanayo na.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.line.0: 가 ilele ukusuka emgceni we-5 ukuya emgceni we-9.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.line.1: 나 ilele ukusuka emgceni we-0 ukuya emgceni we-8.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.line.2: 가, enomgca omkhulu wesiphelo, inde ngakumbi.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.explain: Imigca 3 no-4 inzima ukuthembeka. Imigca 1 no-2 ifunde imigca ngokuchanekileyo. 가 isuka emgceni we-5 ukuya kwi-9, ngoko ngama-4 izithuba, kwaye 나 isuka emgceni we-0 ukuya kwi-8, ngoko ngama-8 izithuba. Umgca wesi-3, othelekise iimpawu zesiphelo kuphela, ungakhathalelanga indawo ezaqala kuyo, ngoko isigqibo somgca wesi-4 nasona asinakuthembeka. Ngolwazi olufunyenwe ngoku, isigwebo sokuqala sika-Eunseo kufuneka silungiswe.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.prompt: Nangaphandle komlawuli, unganibeka njani iipensile ezimbini ukuze uthelekise ubude bazo ngokuthembekileyo? Khetha zonke iindlela ezifanelekileyo.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.hint.0: Cinga ngokwenzekayo ukuba ubeka iipensile ezimbini secaleni ngesiphelo esinye sinxiba kwikona yedesika.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.hint.1: Xa isiphelo esinye sisemgceni ofanayo, yitsho ukuba kufuneka ujonge phi kwisiphelo esisele ukuze uthelekise ubude.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.a: Linganisa iziphelo zasekhohlo zepensile ezimbini kumgca ofanayo ujonge iziphelo zasekunene
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.a: Le ngcamango ithi xa usulungelelanise isiphelo esinye, kufuneka uthelekise kuphela indawo yesiphelo esisele.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.b: Linganisa iziphelo zasekunene zepensile ezimbini kumgca ofanayo ujonge iziphelo zasekhohlo
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.b: Le ngcamango ithi ungalungelelanisa nasiphi na isiphelo.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.c: Beka iipensile ezimbini zikude komnye nomnye ujonge ngamehlo
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.c: Zibonwa zikude, zibonakala zahlukile ngokuxhomekeke apho zibekwe khona nakumgangatho wamehlo akho. Cinga ukuba oko kufana nokuzibeka ecaleni ukuthelekisa.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.d: Yithi ipensile enesiphelo sasekunene esiphumela ngaphandle ngakumbi inde ngakumbi, ngokunjalo
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.d: Uthwale njengoko injalo impazamo yokujonga kuphela isiphelo sasekunene esibonwa kwingxaki yomlawuli.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.explain: Ukuba ulungelelanisa isiphelo esinye kumgca ofanayo, ipensile enesiphelo esisele esiphumela ngaphandle ngakumbi inde ngakumbi. Akunamsebenzi ukuba ulungelelanisa siphi isiphelo. Ukuzibeka zikude okanye ukujonga isiphelo esinye kuphela akukuthelekisa okuthembekileyo.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.acc.0: Indlela yokulungelelanisa iziphelo zasekhohlo ithembekile. Kulungile ukwazi ukuba ukulungelelanisa iziphelo zasekunene kwenza ukuthelekisa okufanayo.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.acc.1: Indlela yokulungelelanisa iziphelo zasekunene nayo ithembekile. Kulungile ukwazi ukuba ukulungelelanisa iziphelo zasekhohlo kwenza ukuthelekisa okufanayo.

y-m-02-01.title: Ngaba amakhadi amade okanye atyekeleyo nawo ayiquadrilateral?
y-m-02-01.goal: Fumana umgca ongalunganga kwingcamango ethatha iquadrilateral ngokuxineneyo njengo-'mi ngqo enamacala amane amde alinganayo', usete umgangatho wokugweba ngenani lemigca ethe tye neekona ezibukhali, uze uchaze iiquadrilateral ezinde okanye ezityekeleyo.
y-m-02-01.material: U-Harin uqokelele amakhadi amathathu equadrilateral. Ikhadi 가 limi ngqo kwaye yonke imigca emine ethe tye inobude obufanayo. Ikhadi 나 lide ecaleni, ngoko imigca ephezulu neseleyo mide kwaye imigca emibini yecala mifutshane. Ikhadi 다 linemo efanayo no-가 kodwa litye ukuze ikona ebukhali ibe ngaphezulu. Onke amakhadi amathathu ajikelezwe yimigca emine ethe tye kwaye anee kona ezine ezibukhali. (Akukho mfanekiso, ngoko yicinge ngamagama.) U-Harin wacinga ngolu hlobo.
y-m-02-01.thinking.0: Hlola ukuba umgca ngamnye wesisombululo unesizathu
y-m-02-01.thinking.2: Yenza uchaze, ngamagama, umzekelo wenye imo ehambelana nomgangatho
y-m-02-01.prereq.0: Unokuqaphela iimo zonxantathu, iquadrilateral, nesangqa uzibize ngamagama azo.
y-m-02-01.prereq.1: Unokubala 'imigca ethe tye' 'neekona ezibukhali' ngokukhomba ngomnwe. (Ukubala amanani ukuya kwi-4)
y-m-02-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca omnye wengcinga ka-Harin onzima ukuthembela kuwo. (Imigca emibini inokuba nzima ukuthembela kuyo.)
y-m-02-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumakhadi amathathu, khomba ngomnwe wakho ubale ukuba zingaphi imigca ethe tye neekona ezibukhali.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye, wahlula ukuba isizathu esinikwe nguHarin 'sibaliwe' okanye 'luvakalelo olusuka ekujongekeni.'
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.0: Ikhadi 가 linemigca emine ethe tye neekona ezine ezibukhali, ngoko liyiquadrilateral.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.1: Ikhadi 나 lide ecaleni, ngoko asiyiquadrilateral.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.2: Ikhadi 다 litye, kodwa linemigca emine ethe tye neekona ezine ezibukhali.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko iquadrilateral kufuneka ibe nemigca emine ethe tye yonke inobude obufanayo.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.explain: Imigca 2 no-4 inzima ukuthembela kuyo. Imigca 1 no-3 yathethwa ngokubala imigca ethe tye neekona ezibukhali. Umgca 2 wagqitywa ngokujonga kuphela 'lide', kwaye umgca 4 wolule oko kwabonwa kwikhadi 가 kuphela waba 'kufuneka zonke zibe nobude obufanayo'. Nokuba lide okanye litye, imigca emine ethe tye neekona ezine ezibukhali ziyahlala zinjalo.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.prompt: Xa ugqiba ukuba ikhadi 나 liyiquadrilateral okanye hayi, yintoni eyona nto ithembekileyo ukuyijonga?
y-m-02-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khangela into engatshintshiyo nokuba uyajika ikhadi 나 okanye uyalizoba likhulu.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.hint.1: Xela oko kufanayo nokwahlukileyo phakathi kwamakhadi 가, 나, kunye no-다.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.o.a: Jonga ukuba linobungakanani obufanayo nekhadi lokuqala lequadrilateral olibonileyo
y-m-02-01.s.s2.r.a: Ubungakanani asiso sikhomba sokugqiba igama lemo. Iquadrilateral enkulu neyincinci zombini ziiquadrilateral.

y-m-02-01.s.s2.r.d: Ubale into enokusetyenziselwa ukugqiba igama lemo. Sisikhomba esingatshintshiyo nokuba imo inde incinci okanye itye.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.explain: Ukuba zingaphi imigca ethe tye neekona ezibukhali ziziikhomba ezingatshintshiyo nokuba wenza imo ibe nkulu okanye uyayijika. Ubungakanani, icala ebekwe kulo, nokuba iinde ziyafana na azinakusetyenziswa njengomgangatho wokugqiba igama lemo.
y-m-02-01.s.s3.prompt: Bhala oko wawuya kukuthi ku-Harin. Chaza ngamagama ikhadi elinye elijongeka lahlukile kuno-가 kodwa lisiyiquadrilateral (umzekelo, lide kangakanani, libekwe njani), uze ubhale isizathu sokuba lingabizwa ngokuba yiquadrilateral.

y-m-02-02.title: Ngaba Okukhulu Kunzima? Ukulinyusa nokulilinganisa
y-m-02-02.goal: Bona nini umbono 'okukhulu kunzima' ulungile nalapho ungalunganga, qhubeka ulungisa isigwebo sakho ixesha ngalinye xa kuvela ulwazi olutsha, uze wenze ibini elifana ngobungakanani kodwa elibonakala lahlukile ngobunzima.
y-m-02-02.material: UJiho uthe, "Okukhulu kunzima." Utitshala uthe masivavanye amazwi kaJiho. Ubonisa izinto ezimbini ngexesha, uzinyusa ngezandla zombini, kwaye ekugqibeleni uhlola ngokuzibeka kwisikali sebhalansi. (Kwisikali sebhalansi, icala elinzima liyehla.)
y-m-02-02.thinking.0: Gqiba ukutshintsha okanye ukugcina isigwebo sakho ngolwazi olutsha
y-m-02-02.thinking.1: Wahlula iimeko apho kunjalo neemeko apho kungenjalo
y-m-02-02.prereq.0: Amava okunyusa izinto ezimbini ngezandla zombini uthi zinzima/zilula
y-m-02-02.prereq.1: Ukwazi ukuba kwisikali sebhalansi (isisawu), icala elehlayo linzima ngakumbi.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.prompt: Ixesha ngalinye xa kuvela ulwazi olutsha, cinga ukuba leliphi icala eliza kuba nzima ngakumbi. Xa kuvela ulwazi olutsha, kulungile ukugcina umbono wakho okanye ukuwutshintsha.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.hint.0: Jonga iqhekeza ngalinye lolwazi kuqala uxele into enye efanayo neyahlukileyo kwibini lokugqibela.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.hint.1: Xela ukuba impendulo oyikhethileyo isekelwe kwiphuphu elini kolu lwazi.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Ibini lokuqala: amatye amabini ohlobo olufanayo. Elinye likhulu njengepuphu kwaye elinye lincinci njengechestnut.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ucinga ukuba leliphi icala eliza kuba nzima ngakumbi?
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukuba ngamatye ohlobo olufanayo, kulungile ukuqikelela ukuba ilitye elikhulu linzima ngakumbi nokuthi uza kugqiba emva kokuwanyusa. Kule bini, 'okukhulu kunzima' kuhambelana kakuhle.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Oku kusebenzise ingcamango yokuba xa kuhlobo olufanayo, elikhulu linezinto ezininzi ngaphakathi.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Akukabikho sikhomba sokucinga ukuba elincinci linzima. Khumbula ukuba sisiphi isikhomba esikwenze wacinga njalo.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Lo ngumbono onolumkiso ofuna ukuhlola kuqala. Cinga nokuba zingaphi izikhomba.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Xa kunyuswa ngezandla zombini, isandla esibambe ilitye elikhulu sehle ngakumbi. Ibini lesibini luhlobo olwahlukileyo. Elinye libhola yesiponji ekhulu njengezintende ezimbini (iya phantsi kwangoko xa uyicinezela), nelinye yimabula yensimbi encinci njengesikhumba somnwe.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ngeli xesha, ucinga ukuba leliphi icala eliza kuba nzima ngakumbi?
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Ngenxa yokuba ibini lokuqala lalichanekile, awukwazi ukusebenzisa ingcamango efanayo kule bini. Oku kungenxa yokuba izinto zahlukile. Kokubini ukuqikelela ukuba imabula yensimbi ibonakala inzima ngakumbi nokuthi kunzima ukugqiba ngobungakanani bodwa kuyafaneleka.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Uthwale ingcamango eyayichanekile kwibini lokuqala njengoko injalo. Kule bini, kuqala hlola ukuba izinto ziyafana na.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Usebenzise umahluko wezinto (isiponji esinokucinezelwa nensimbi eqinileyo) njengesikhomba.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Izinto zahlukile, ngoko kunzima ukugqiba ngobungakanani bodwa
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ubone ukuba kufuneka isikhomba esingengobungakanani. Cinga nokuba wenze ntoni ukuhlola.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Xa kubekwe kwisikali sebhalansi, icala elinemabula encinci yensimbi lehlile. Icala elineebhola enkulu yesiponji lenyukile.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yeyiphi indlela elungileyo yokulungisa amazwi kaJiho "Okukhulu kunzima"?
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Kuyanceda phakathi kwezinto zohlobo olufanayo, kodwa xa iintlobo zahlukile, ubungakanani bodwa abunakugqiba ubunzima. Ngoko 'rhoqo' liqinile kakhulu, kwaye nokuba uqikelela ngobungakanani, kuthembeke ngakumbi ukuhlola ngokunyusa okanye ngokusebenzisa isikali.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Akunjalo rhoqo. Xa kwakuhlobo olufanayo, elikhulu belinzima ngakumbi, kodwa xa iintlobo zahlukile kwahlukile.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ndiyahlule kumatye amabini nakwiibini ezimbini zesiponji nemabula yensimbi ndathetha.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ubungakanani abubalulekanga kwaphela. Elincinci linzima ngakumbi.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Welule isiphumo sebini elinye ukugubungela zonke iimeko. Khumbula kwakhona ukuba amatye ebini lokuqala ayenjani.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: UJiho unyanisile. Ibhola yesiponji inkulu, ngoko isikali siphosisile.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Xa ulindelo nesiphumo zahlukile, uthandabuzile isiphumo. Jonga kwakhona ukuba uhlole ntoni ngesikali.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Musa ukugqiba ngobungakanani; kufuneka uhlole ngokunyusa okanye ngokubeka kwisikali.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ukhethe indlela yokuhlola ngqo kunokuhamba ngobungakanani.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.reflect: Kwibini lokuqala, ingcamango 'ilitye elikhulu linzima ngakumbi' yayisisigwebo esinokugcinwa, kwaye kwibini lesibini, ulwazi olutsha lokuba izinto zitshintsha lwathetha ukuba loo ngcamango ayinakusetyenziswa njengoko injalo. Isitshixo salo msebenzi kukuthi ngaphandle kwamaqhekeza athile olwazi ingcamango yakho ichanekile ngokongeza iimeko.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.prompt: Bhala ibini elinye lezinto ezimbini ezijongeka zifana ngobungakanani kodwa ezibonakala zahlukile kakhulu ngobunzima. Bhala nendlela oya kuhlola ngayo.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.hint.0: Cinga ngezinto ezimbini ekhlasini okanye ekhaya uthelekise ubungakanani bazo kuqala.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ungaziva njani ukuba uzibambe enye isandla ngasinye, kwaye leliphi icala eliza kwehla ukuba uzibeka kwisikali.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.placeholder: Umzekelo: ... kunye ne-... zifana ngobungakanani, kodwa ...
y-m-02-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba izinto ezimbini ozikhethileyo zifana ngokwenene ngobungakanani?
y-m-02-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba ugqibe ukuba leyiphi kwezi zimbini oyicingayo inzima ngakumbi?
y-m-02-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ngaba unokuthelekisa ngokwenene ubunzima ngendlela oyibhalileyo?
y-m-02-02.s.s2.model.0: Ibhola yekotoni nelitye elincinci zifana ngobungakanani, kodwa ndicinga ukuba ilitye elincinci linzima ngakumbi. Ndiya kuhlola ngokubamba enye isandla ngasinye okanye ngokuzibeka kwisikali sebhalansi.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.model.1: Ibhokisi engenanto nebhokisi enencwadi zifana ngobungakanani, kodwa ibhokisi enencwadi inzima ngakumbi. Ukuba ndizibeka kwisisawu, ndingaxela ukuba leliphi icala elehlayo.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Umzekelo apho into ephakathi kwento enye ihlukile nawo uyasebenza.

y-m-02-04.title: Ingaba ikomityi ende iqulathe amanzi amaninzi?
y-m-02-04.goal: Khetha iindlela ezithembekileyo zokuvavanya ingcamango ethi 'ukuba ide, iqulathe ngakumbi', gweba ngesiphumo sokuthululela ukusuka kwenye ukuya kwenye, wenze ngamazwi imilo yeekomityi apho loo ngcamango ingalunganga.
y-m-02-04.material: Ikomityi 가 yikomityi ende kakhulu, encinci ngobubanzi. Ikomityi 나 yikomityi emfutshane, banzi kakhulu. Zombini iikomityi zivulekile phezulu kwaye zigudileyo ngaphakathi. UAin wathi, "가 ide ngakumbi, ngoko 가 iqulathe amanzi amaninzi." UJunho wathi, "Masingagwebi ngoko sikubonayo, masikhangele ngamanzi."
y-m-02-04.prereq.0: Amava okuzalisa ikomityi ngamanzi ude ufike emphethweni
y-m-02-04.s.s1.prompt: Khetha zonke iindlela zokufumana ngokuthembekileyo ukuba yeyiphi ikomityi equlathe amanzi amaninzi.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ngaphandle kokujonga ngamehlo, cinga ngendlela yokuthelekisa iikomityi ezimbini ngamanzi okwenene.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.hint.1: Yitsho ngamazwi, enye ngenye, indlela nganye ilinganisa okanye ithelekisa ntoni ngokwenene, ukhangele ukuba kuyafana na 'nobuninzi bamanzi aqulathwe yikomityi'.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.o.a: Beka iikomityi ezimbini secaleni ujonge ukuphakama kuphela
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.a: Ukuphakama sisalathiso esinye kuphela. Awukwazi ukuxela ukuba ikomityi ibanzi kangakanani.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.o.b: Thulula amanzi agcwele phezulu ekomityini 가 uwafake ekomityini 나 ujonge
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.b: Le yindlela yokuthulula amanzi ngqo ukuthelekisa ubukhulu beekomityi ezimbini. Cinga nangendlela yokufunda isiphumo.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.c: Uya kuba ulinganisa ikomityi ngokwayo. Cinga ukuba oko kufana nobuninzi bamanzi eliqulathe.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.o.d: Bala ukuba zingaphi izihlandlo ozizalisa ngazo ngesikhongozeli esincinci esifanayo
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.d: Le yindlela esebenzisa isikhongozeli esifanayo njengeyunithi ithelekise iikomityi ezimbini ngomlinganiselo ofanayo.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.explain: Ukuba uthulula amanzi ngqo okanye ubala izihlandlo zokuzalisa ngesikhongozeli esifanayo, unokuthelekisa ubuninzi bamanzi aqulathwe zikomityi, nokuba imilo yeekomityi injani. Ukujonga ukuphakama kuphela okanye ukuphakamisa iikomityi ezingenanto akuthelekisi ngqo ubuninzi bamanzi aqulathwe zizo.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.acc.0: Ukuthulula kodwa kunokunika isiphumo esithembekileyo. Kulungile ukwazi ukuba kukho nendlela yokubala ngesikhongozeli esifanayo.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.acc.1: Indlela yokubala izihlandlo ngesikhongozeli esincinci esifanayo nayo ithembekile. Kulungile ukwazi ukuba kukho nendlela yokuthulula.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.prompt: UJunho wazalisa ikomityi 가 ngamanzi wawathulula onke ekomityini 나 ngaphandle kokuchitha ithontsi, kwaye amanzi akwikomityi 나 azalisa malunga nesiqingatha kuphela sekomityi. Ungathini ngesi siphumo?
y-m-02-04.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ngamazwi zombini ukuba amanzi akwikomityi 가 ayeyisixa esipheleleyo nokuba ikomityi 나 ayizalisiwe ngawo.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.hint.1: Emva kokuthulula onke amanzi ekomityini 가, zoba umfanekiso wokuba ikomityi 나 izalise kude kangakanani nokuba ingaba ikho indawo engenanto.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.a: Ufunde ukuba amanzi athululiweyo awazalisanga ikomityi, wathelekisa ubukhulu beekomityi ezimbini.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.b: Beke ingcamango yokuqala yokuba ide phambi kwesiphumo. Cinga ukuba kuthetha ntoni ukuba onke amanzi e-가 afudusiwe kwaye 나 ayizalanga.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.o.c: Iikomityi ezimbini ziqulathe isixa samanzi esifanayo
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.c: Jonga ukuba amanzi azalise ikomityi azalise ikomityi 나 na.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.d: Ukukhangela kwakhona yinto elungileyo. Kodwa ukuba onke amanzi afudusiwe ngaphandle kokuchitheka, jonga ukuba likho na into oyivumela isiphumo esi sodwa ukuba uyithi.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.explain: Amanzi azalise ikomityi 가 azalise malunga nesiqingatha kuphela sekomityi 나, ngoko ikomityi 나 inokuqulatha amanzi amaninzi kunalawo. Ingcamango yokuqala (ukuba ide, iqulathe ngakumbi) ayizange ilunge kula mabini eekomityi.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.prompt: Chaza ngamazwi iikomityi ezimbini ezintsha (ikomityi 다 kunye nekomityi 라) apho "ukuba ide ngakumbi, iqulathe amanzi amaninzi" kukaAin kungalunganga. Kufuneka zibe zikomityi ezahlukileyo kwi-가 ne-나; bhala ukuphakama nobubanzi beekomityi ezimbini ngamanani okanye ngamagama (umz. ukuphakama 20 cm, ububanzi 3 cm), ubhale nokuba yeyiphi ikomityi equlathe amanzi amaninzi.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.hint.0: Cinga iikomityi ezimbini ngokukhetha amanani ahlukileyo kwi-가 ne-나 (ukuphakama nge-cm, ububanzi nge-cm). Jonga ukuba yintoni enye eyahlukileyo ngaphandle kokuphakama.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.hint.1: Cinga ngokuzalisa iikomityi zombini ngamanzi ukuya kukuphakama okufanayo uthelekise ukuba yeyiphi icala eliqulathe amanzi amaninzi.

y-m-02-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ngaba ukwazile ukukhangela ukuba amazwi am alungile ngokuthulula okanye ngokubala ngesikhongozeli esifanayo?

y-m-02-06.title: Ukuhombisa iposta ngamaqhekeza ayi-8: ziziphi iindlela ezinokwenzeka?

(Akukho mfanekiso, ngoko cinga ngenani lamaqhekeza kuphela.)

y-m-02-06.s.s3.hint.1: Xa kukho iqwenga e-1 yekwadrilatharali, jonga enye ngenye ukuba onxantathu bangaphi ukuya kwangaphi kunokwenzeka.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.o.a: Zifumane njengoko zisiza engqondweni uze umise xa kungasafikeli nto engqondweni
y-m-02-06.s.s3.r.a: Akukho ndlela yokujonga ukuba kugqithiswe okuthile. Cinga ngendlela onokwazi ngayo ukuba izibini ozifumeneyo zizozonke.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.o.b: Misela inani leziqwenga zekwadrilatharali enye ngexesha uze wahlule eziseleyo
y-m-02-06.s.s3.r.b: Le yindlela yokumisela into enye uze utshintshe eseleyo ngokulandelelana.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.o.c: Fumana indlela enye kuphela esebenzisa onxantathu abaninzi kakhulu
y-m-02-06.s.s3.r.c: Ucinge ukuba ugqibile xa ufumana umzekelo omnye. Esi senzo sijonge ukuba zikho ezininzi ezinokwenzeka.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.o.d: Misela inani leziqwenga zesangqa esinye ngexesha uze wahlule eziseleyo
y-m-02-06.s.s3.r.d: Le yindlela yokumisela enye eyahlukileyo uze utshintshe eseleyo ngokulandelelana. Cinga ukuba ungazifumana zonke ngaphandle kwezikhewu nokuba umisela yiphi imilo.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.explain: Ukuba umisela inani lemilo enye uze utshintshe eseleyo enye ngexesha, unokwazi ukuba ukhangele kude kangakanani, ngoko unokuzifumana ungagqithisanga nanye. Ukuba ujonga njengoko zisiza engqondweni okanye umise kwenye, awunakwazi ukuba kugqithiswe isibini na.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.acc.0: Indlela yokumisela inani leziqwenga zekwadrilatharali yindlela yokuzifumana ungagqithisanga nanye. Indlela yokumisela izangqa iyafana.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.acc.1: Indlela yokumisela inani leziqwenga zesangqa nayo yindlela yokuzifumana ungagqithisanga nanye. Indlela yokumisela iikwadrilatharali iyafana.
